note: Clusters manifest. startDate: before this game day the game keeps using clusters-data.js. queue: a puzzle for a given date (game day changes at 03:00 London time). rotation: puzzles used, in turn, on any date with no queue entry. replay: the shelf, plus every queued puzzle whose day has passed. To add a new puzzle: save it as sandbox-clusters.NN.json, add a queue line with its date, and add NN to replay once it should show there.
